278970867.description:
Tobacco Pipe Lot - 4 Pieces
Mixed Estate Styles, Briar Wood and Rusticated Finishes
Vintage Collection
This lot features four vintage estate tobacco pipes, showcasing a variety of classic shapes and finishes popular throughout the mid-to-late 20th century. The collection includes both smooth briar wood and textured rusticated surfaces, representing a range of traditional pipe craftsmanship. These pieces are ideal for collectors of smoking memorabilia or enthusiasts looking to restore and enjoy classic estate pipes.
Lot of four individual tobacco pipes in varying sizes and shapes
Includes three smooth-finish pipes and one rusticated (textured) finish pipe
Stems include classic black and one translucent amber-colored acrylic or lucite variant
One pipe features a decorative silver-toned metal band on the shank
Condition:
Overall lot shows signs of previous use consistent with vintage estate pipes. Bowls exhibit carbon buildup and charring from smoking. Stems show typical oxidation and light tooth chatter marks. The wood surfaces retain good color with minor scuffs and surface wear visible. The metal band shows light tarnishing. Items are sold as-is for collection or restoration.
